steps.en: Staff sign in and reach ACM if they have ACM access.
steps.id: Staff login dan masuk ke ACM kalau punya akses ACM.
steps.why_en: Portal login is not part of this system; the application screens are not checked behind the screen.
steps.why_id: Login portal bukan bagian sistem ini; layar application tidak dicek di balik layar.

steps.en: The menu only appears for the admin role.
steps.id: Menu hanya muncul untuk role admin.
steps.why_en: Only the menu is limited; nothing behind the screen checks the admin role.
steps.why_id: Hanya menu yang dibatasi; tidak ada pengecekan role admin di balik layar.

steps.en: The list shows every current application by ID and name.
steps.id: Daftar menampilkan semua application dengan ID dan nama.

steps.en: Staff can search and export the list.
steps.id: Staff bisa mencari dan mengekspor daftar.
steps.why_en: There is no way for staff to sort the columns.

steps.en: Add New Application opens a form with the required fields.
steps.id: Add New Application membuka form dengan field yang diminta.

steps.en: The form checks field length and URL format.
steps.id: Form mengecek panjang field dan format URL.
steps.why_en: Checks run in the screen only; the URL rule is loose and not checked behind the screen.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan hanya di layar; aturan URL longgar dan tidak dicek di balik layar.

steps.en: Submitting saves the new application; duplicate IDs are refused.
steps.id: Submit menyimpan application baru; ID kembar ditolak.

steps.en: Staff can change the description and the URL, not only the description.
steps.id: Staff bisa ubah description dan URL, bukan hanya description.
steps.why_en: The flow allows description only; the system also lets staff change the URL.
steps.why_id: Flow hanya mengizinkan description; sistem juga mengizinkan ubah URL.

steps.en: Deleting asks for confirmation first, then removes the application.
steps.id: Hapus meminta konfirmasi dulu, lalu menghapus application.

steps.en: Deleting an application removes its modules, roles and functions too.
steps.id: Hapus application ikut menghapus module, role, dan function-nya.

steps.en: A problem shows a pop-up saying something went wrong.
steps.id: Masalah menampilkan pop-up bahwa terjadi kesalahan.
steps.why_en: The pop-up is generic and does not show the actual reason, such as a duplicate ID.
steps.why_id: Pop-up bersifat umum dan tidak menampilkan alasan sebenarnya, misalnya ID kembar.
